title: How do I record a member's own confirmation of Pro Shop Store Credit account closure?
content:
## Situation of use
This tool records a member's own confirmation, in their own voice, that they are closing their Pro Shop Store Credit account. It changes the account's lifecycle status from active to closed and records today's date as the account's closed date.

## How it is invoked
Because closing the account is an action the member takes for themselves, this tool must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves: confirm_account_closure_988c79ea.

## Parameters
- credit_account_id: the store-credit account's own reference number, reachable by looking up the member's store-credit account before the call.

## Return
A successful call returns a confirmation naming the account's own reference number, its new status, and the closed date recorded. A status of closed in that confirmation is how the representative knows the closure was recorded.
